# Anne Shirley & Cornelia Bryant

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) — close friend and confidante · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), +2 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enjoy their peaceful early autumn at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), reflecting on their idyllic honeymoon and Gilbert's professional success. Later, Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) visits, sitting on their doorstep and entertaining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with her sharp-tongued opinions and village gossip.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

> Miss Cornelia shares her sharp opinions on men, the local minister, and mutual acquaintances while visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After completing her sewing, Miss Cornelia accepts Anne's warm invitation to stay for tea.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P71](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0071), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P74](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0074), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P81](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0081)_

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and recounts the tragic life story of their neighbor, [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). She explains how [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) suffered family tragedies, was coerced into marrying [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), and now lives bound to him after he returned from a sea voyage with permanent brain damage.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)_

> Miss Cornelia asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her encounter with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) on the shore and encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persist in being Leslie's friend despite her cold demeanor. Moved by Leslie's tragic life and loneliness, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to do everything she can to win Leslie's friendship.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P41](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend pleasant autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). Walking home afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's potential, tease each other about past suitors, and look forward to the coming spring at their lit home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P4](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P18](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. The guests enjoy lively conversation and stories before Captain Jim heads back to the lighthouse at sunset.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P0](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

> During the winter at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the emotional barrier and occasional resentment she senses from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), despite their shared activities and Leslie's gift of handmade baby clothes. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his written life-book, which she realizes could be made into a great masterpiece by the right writer.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P21](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0021)_

> Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the little house, bringing spring gifts and engaging in lively debates on theology, local gossip, and neighbors. Susan Baker returns with news about an ill acquaintance, leading to a humorous exchange that causes [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Captain Jim to excuse themselves to laugh.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P57](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes into labor and gives birth to a baby girl, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name Joyce. However, the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken and struggling through a painful recovery.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P30](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0030)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) insist that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) take it easy and keep [Susan](../character/susan.md) on to handle the household duties. Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim visit, sharing jokes and news, including word that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), the grandson of the house's original builder, will be boarding with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) for the summer.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P3](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)_

> [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) drops [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) off at Anne's house before rushing away to an emergency. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks Owen to Leslie's home, chatting with him about his writing ambitions and connection to the area, before introducing him to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and [Dick](../character/dick.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P34](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0034)_

> While [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is away attending an emergency, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he is deeply in love with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) listens with sympathy and compassion, advising him that he must leave in silence. Miss Cornelia arrives, cutting through the emotional tension with her sensible humor.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and discusses funny obituaries, religious evangelists, and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives, and later [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares her grief over her dog's death. After returning from a holiday trip to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) learn from Captain Jim that Owen's book based on his life story has been accepted for publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) consults Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) should be told about the possibility of an operation for [Dick](../character/dick.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) informs [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who cold-bloodedly decides to take [Dick](../character/dick.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the procedure, despite Anne's fears for her happiness. Afterwards, Miss Cornelia confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anger over Gilbert's intervention, though she eventually accepts that the decision is made.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P30](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) finances and undergoes the journey to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) so [Dick](../character/dick.md) can have his operation. Later, after a successful surgery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a shocking letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that the man believed to be [Dick](../character/dick.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) the surprising details from Leslie's letter, revealing that the man thought to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), making [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) a free woman. They discuss George's past, Leslie's situation, and [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) subtly suggests informing [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) about Leslie's freedom.
>

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P0](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P18](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing immense joy and relief to the household after her previous loss. They decide to name the boy [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md), and the friends and family visit to admire the newborn while Miss Cornelia and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Owen Ford's upcoming visit.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

> Following an election victory for the Liberals, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share the political news. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the lighthouse, where she meets a newly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) and speaks with Captain Jim about his feelings on aging and mortality.
>

> [Susan](../character/susan.md) leaves to care for her sister after an accident, and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) moves into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to stay with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while [Susan](../character/susan.md) is away. [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visits and meets [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) there, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tell [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) that Owen has returned to court her.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P40](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P49](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0049)_

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to share the shocking news that she is getting married to [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) playfully teases her about her past claims and gives her humorously ironic rules for managing a husband, which Miss Cornelia takes in good stride.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she joyfully returns his feelings. Later, Captain Jim joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Owen by the fireplace to share a solemn farewell and bestow a loving blessing upon them all. After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) congratulates [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with gossip about [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's upcoming marriage.
>
